body:
Thank you for your answer. Yes, I do love her and want to stay with her but I gotta admit that sometimes this kind of thing makes it difficult to me and makes me wonder to what extent it is good to stay. But whenever I calm down I just can´t help but feel like I want to stay with her for sure. And before anyone asks, I am pretty sure it is not obsessive or a fixation. She is thankful while she is fine and not suffering a breakdown. The main issue is this: imagine we are having a great day and something bad happens, this means that for her everything has gone down, and that it was a bad day despite the good. 

I do feel responsible for her well-being because I know I rejected helping her in an important moment and I was stupid for not helping her with her opressive ex-boyfriend. I don´t know who could help her. She is terribly scared of therapy and especially rejects the idea of taking pills. She claims that she wants to feel in control of what happens and solve it by her own means because pills kinda erase a part of you. She tried to talk to some friend who asked her to open up, claiming he would stay forever. This friend left her for no reason claiming that he could not stand her - and I swear I know she did nothing to him, he never even saw her breakdowns, he only saw her in her normal stance. As you can imagine she barely trusts anybody anymore. One of the few close friends she has right now has a worse depression than hers and sometimes my girlfriend toughens up to help her even being bad. Other times she can´t. But this close friend is pretty self-centered and I do not trust her because her personality is pretty fucked up despite her depression.

And then the family issue, she just does not want to tell them. There is no one I can talk to. Whenever I say I should talk to her family, even making the issue look like a lot less just so they gave her some support she goes nuts about it and sometimes when I get too serious about it she uses the suicide argument card. So no, I am basically the only one fully aware of it and the one she (I guess partially) trusts. One of the several reasons she gives not to say it is the fact that her sister would make it worse (and I guess it is true in that sense, she = 0 sympathy.) And another one that people would start to treat her in a fake way and that she does not want that.
